cryptokeyhole.methodology: Reads issuer daily holdings file; checks XRP against shares times XRP/share, NAV times shares against net assets, and net assets divided by price against coins, within 0.05% plus rounding.
cryptokeyhole.limitation: Secondary extraction of issuer file; no quarter-end SEC filing yet overlaps the daily series for independent quarter-end validation.
